title: Senate to scrutinize reallocations in HGAB, says Ejercito

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Senate finance panel chairperson Sen. JV Ejercito said the Senate will scrutinize the budget realignments in the House General Appropriations Bill, which cut budgets on major government programs. In a press briefing, Ejercito confirmed major changes in the House GAB including the P130 billion cut on the Foreign Assistance Projects and a P9.5 billion reduction on calamity funds. “Striking para sa’kin lalong-lalo na ‘yung pagtatanggal sa malalaking programa,” he said.
